subject_session: Achilles / Achilles_10252013 (primary, fully completed); multi-session loop truncated at session 4 of 5, no fig08 or per-session output produced

headline_stat.name: Either-direction place cells among CA1 pyramidal cells (single session)

stated_limitation: Three of the eight sessions used a circular maze. The direction-flip below assumes an open-ended linear track, so the analysis is limited to the five linear-track sessions (Cicero_09172014 used a 2 m track, the rest 1.6 m).

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsaki dorsal-CA1 silicon-probe linear-track recordings, subject Achilles) is the canonical dataset for hippocampal place fields, with 120 putative pyramidal cells and 83 traversals.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via LINDI with the mislabelled SpatialSeries rate/period corrected, traversals segmented from the NaN structure with dropout bridging and a 60% coverage criterion, speed thresholding, explicit spike-count and peak-rate inclusion criteria, and a committed linearisation-validation panel.
justification.analysis: Skaggs spatial information against a within-running-epoch circular-shift null with a sound justification, odd/even-lap stability, direction-separated maps, and cross-validated Bayesian decoding with a map-permutation control; only a multiple-comparison correction across tested units is absent and would not change the direction of a near-universal effect.
justification.correctness: 56%/50% per-direction and 71% either-direction place cells, median SI 0.63 bits/spike, 28 cm fields, and 5.5 cm decoding error versus 50.1 cm control all reproduce from the committed logs and are internally consistent with the figure titles and the figures themselves.
justification.figures: Figures 1-7 are readable, labelled with units and sample sizes, and the population triptych and decoding panels make the case cleanly, but the write-up's referenced Figure 8 does not exist and the Figure 7 posterior panel is somewhat dark/overplotted.
justification.honesty: The single-session phenomenon is honestly and fully supported with no fabricated numbers, but the committed Summary and Figure 8 caption assert a completed five-session replication that no produced output or figure supports and no single-session caveat is given, a mild overstatement of scope that keeps this out of the 3 band.
justification.verdict: The core single-session analysis is publication-quality and I would believe it, but I would require the unfinished five-session claims and the missing Figure 8 to be completed or removed and a single-session caveat added before accepting.
